en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a rural railway station and a church with a tall clock tower and steep roof. A railway track curves in the foreground, with telegraph poles and a stone kilometer marker beside it. To the left stands a small station building labeled "SANZENO". On the right is a parish church with a prominent bell tower and a cross monument in front. The caption in Italian is printed in red along the bottom border.
